title: comments: the @mention picker offers a member who cannot read the thread, and the author is never told that person will not be notified
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ② a silent drop of what the author asked for. Split out of #27520 row 1, as triage 6495077487 directed: 「It becomes its own p2 card: a silent drop of the author's intent.」 Observed by the 18.3.0 RC walkthrough at `c4c515ad`. Mechanism read at `origin/main` `a75ddba1`. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane.

## Business reason

Who: anyone who @mentions a colleague in a record's Discussion. What happens: the picker offers a member who cannot read that thread. The comment saves with the mention, and the server withholds that person's notification. Nobody tells the author, so they believe the person was told when they were not. The rendered mention also looks like plain typed text.

## Mechanism (read, not reproduced here)

- **Server:** `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/mention-recipient-gate.ts` withholds a recipient for `cannot_read_source` or `cannot_read_thread` (~L84–92, L192). Its own docblock says the reason is 「Logged; never shown to the author」.
- **Picker:** the suggestions are built in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (`mentionSuggestions`, ~L780 and ~L2532) and fed through `ui/packages/react/src/context/DiscussionContext.tsx` (`DiscussionMentionSuggestion`). That file sits on the record page, in seat 1's area, and has open PRs #27636 and #27592.
- **Rendering:** `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RichTextCommentInput.tsx`.

## Wanted (the route is triage's call)

Either leave non-readers out of the picker, or tell the author after save which mentions will not be notified. Either way the author is no longer misled. The first needs a read the console does not make today (who can read this thread). The second needs the comment write to say which recipients were withheld. Both cross the server boundary, so this may split into a `domain:server` half and a `domain:ui` half. Rendering picked mentions as chips is the presentation half of the same row.

## Dedupe

I read the 266 most recent issues by title for `mention`, `cannot_read_thread` and `picker`. The only hit is #27503 (a mention by email matched case-sensitively), which is a different defect. **New.**

Links back: #27520 (row 1)
